title: Lab Safety, Tools, and Procedures
purpose: Apply lab safety, apparatus expectations, and replicable procedures.
labDataRequirement: Procedure critique and apparatus identification investigation using diagrams and scenarios only.
safetyNotes: No unsupervised chemical handling. Any real lab tool use requires school/TOR assignment and proper safety controls.
simulationReview: Direct simulation/resource link is provided in P01.html and in directSimulationUrl.
assessmentStimulusNeeded: Use the Unit 1 matrix requirement for this lesson: embedded scenario, table, graph, model, diagram, or organizer as needed.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for safety/procedure practice, measurement/data analysis, and particle models
simulationVirtualLabReviewFocus: Lab safety and procedure critique; apparatus identification
directSimulationStudentTask: After the page opens, use the RAMP safety framework section on the ACS safety page. Read the meaning of Recognize, Assess, Minimize, and Prepare. For the lesson procedure scenario, label one hazard you recognize, one risk you assess, one way to minimize the risk, and one preparation step. Record the four RAMP labels and one sentence explaining which safety decision would prevent the most likely error.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
simulationSourceReference: CPALMS resources; ACS safety resources; Flinn safety references for teacher review
